- MM-03 — Triangulation Gate — "20% ROI per year" is a founder revenue claim; requires 3+ independent signals to verify; 80% motivational content suggests real operational data is absent → triangulation fails
- MM-05 — Hormozi Pivot Detection — vulnerability narrative (debt-financed property teaching) + audience building (50K followers) + course sale ($500) = classic info-product pivot pattern; real money is the course funnel, not the rental properties
- MM-11 — Cross-Domain Pattern Match — matched pattern: `info_product_funnel` (MLM/course guru precedent); creator wins, follower loses; 80% motivational content ratio matches pattern signature
- MM-10 — Unit Economics Gate — "20% ROI" claim with bank loan = must calculate: gross rental yield, net after loan interest (~9-12% VN bank rates 2026), management costs, vacancy; net ROI likely 3-8% after debt service, not 20%
- MM-27 — Ownership vs Labor Income Classifier — course income ($500 × conversion) = LABOR type (active selling); rental with bank loan = SYSTEM, not true OWNERSHIP (bank owns most of the asset); content channel is LABOR; no compounding ownership layer verified
- MM-26 — Revenue Timing Architecture — course revenue = COD/one-time (rank 3), rental income = monthly passive (rank 2), but 80% motivational content ratio signals content-first not operations-first; timing architecture skewed toward labor income

- RF-009 — day_khi_chua_lam — (selling_course) AND NOT(verified_operations): channel teaches property investment but zero evidence of disclosed personal portfolio, debt levels, or verifiable returns → CRITICAL; selling $500 course on unverified operations
